messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — we need final microcopy + inbound routing map for the three landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Also want the webinar hook and follow-up sequence nailed before EOD. Who can take copy variants?
Nish: I can take Hosted API microcopy. Will aim for 3 short headline + 2 sublines each.
Sam: I’ll do Dedicated and Private value bullets — focus on SLA/longevity for Dedicated, security/compliance for Private.
Maya: I can draft the launch-post thread and webinar registration pitch — short, measurable CTAs + UTM plan.
Chris: Ops can set up the routing webhooks and form fields — need exact field names and queue rules from marketing.
Elaine: Perfect. For inbound routing: priority is (1) demo requests, (2) enterprise interest, (3) self-serve/dev questions, (4) webinar RSVPs. Demo/enterprise go to Sales queue; dev questions to DevX; webinar RSVPs to Growth automation.
Nish: For Hosted API copy — roughs: 1) "Ship LLM features today — hosted inference with transparent performance." 2) "Instant API access to production-grade LLMs" 3) "Start small, scale predictably." Subheads: short notes about latency/topology + free credit. Thoughts?
Sam: Dedicated headlines: 1) "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable scale" 2) "Throughput SLAs, private pools, burst options" Private headlines: 1) "Bring inference into your VPC or on-prem" 2) "KMS & audit logs for regulated workloads" Keep bullets <6 words.
Maya: For webinar pitch: subject line idea — "How we cut token cost 3x without breaking QoE" then body: quick bulleted promises + demo time. RSVP form should ask: company size, primary use case, deployment preference (hosted/dedicated/private).
Elaine: Good — now inbound routing mapping. Chris, can you implement this mapping? I'll paste the proposed form -> route matrix:```
form_field:deployment_choice -> values: Hosted, Dedicated, Private
form_field:interest_type -> values: Demo, Enterprise, Technical, Webinar
routing: if interest_type == Demo -> sales-demo-queue
if interest_type == Enterprise -> sales-enterprise-queue
if interest_type == Technical -> devx-support-queue
if interest_type == Webinar -> growth-rsvp-automation
if deployment_choice == Private and interest_type in [Demo, Enterprise] -> priority-enterprise-ops-tag
UTM: source=launch_post, campaign=webinar_march, medium=social
```
Chris: Yep I can wire that as a webhook + simple ruleset. Would like field slugs (e.g., deployment_choice) to be final. Also confirm whether we want immediate slack alerts for Demo/Enterprise?
Elaine: Yes — alert to #sales-notifs for Demo/Enterprise; add a high-priority flag for Private/Enterprise combos. No alerts for Technical (batched to DevX daily).
Maya: For the launch-post thread I’ll prepare: 1 short announcement tweet, 1 longer LinkedIn post, and a product blog CTA that links to each page with UTM variants. Also a gated short demo video for webinar registrants.
Nish: One more thing on microcopy: include a short one-line example under Hosteds like: "Generate polished responses in <100ms p50 (example workload)" — keeps it tangible.
Sam: For Dedicated page, add a small section: "Predictable throughput — sample QPS numbers and expected p95 on common configs." We can include a link to our benchmark page.
Elaine: Action items:
- Nish: finalize Hosted copy + 2 alt CTAs (due 3pm)
- Sam: finalize Dedicated & Private bullets + benchmark snippet (due 3pm)
- Maya: draft launch-posts + webinar RSVP copy + UTM table (due 4pm)
- Chris: stub routing rules and slack alerts (demo/enterprise) by 5pm
- I’ll assemble the final page copy and push to /marketing-assets and tag #design for banner images.
deploy-bot: Deployed routing stub to staging (job 4521) :white_check_mark:
Maya: Quick note — webinar follow-up cadence: 0d: confirmation + video link, 2d: short checklist of what we demo'd, 7d: outreach from Sales for qualified leads. I'll draft email copy.
Elaine: Love it. Keep CTAs consistent across pages: primary CTA: "Get started (free credits)" secondary: "Contact sales" for Dedicated/Private.
Chris: Routing notes captured — will add form slugs to the routing endpoint and share the webhook spec.
Nish: Uploading Hosted copy to Google Doc now -> will ping here when ready.
Elaine: Thanks team — if everyone hits their timeboxes we can publish the landing copy + launch posts by tomorrow morning. :rocket:
Sam: Ack, will push copy to /marketing-assets when done.
Maya: I'll schedule the webinar page and set the automation in Growth later today.
Elaine: Closing — I’ll consolidate and post final bundle to #marketing-assets when everything is in. @everyone, please react with :thumbsup: when done.
